The '''Artichoke''' is a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] [[Crops|crop]] that grows from [[Artichoke Seeds]] after 8 days.  The seeds are available from [[Pierre's General Store]] starting in Year 2.

Artichoke can be acquired before Year 2 through the use of [[Mixed Seeds]].  Artichokes can then be placed in a [[Seed Maker]] to produce [[Artichoke Seeds]].

==Tailoring==
Artichoke is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a dyeable {{Name|Shirt140|link=Tailoring{{!}}Button Down Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the green dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
*Artichoke may be randomly requested in [[Fall]] (year 2+) at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|480}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
